versions.changelog:
ppt-generator-skill-2 v0.1.0

- Initial release of the "ppt-generator" skill.
- Automatically creates visually appealing, professional PPT files based on user-specified topic, industry, and style.
- Supports all industries and both Chinese and English languages.
- Lets users pick templates or use AI-chosen color schemes.
- Fills incomplete inputs by actively searching for market data, trends, and cases.
- Ensures structure, data-rich content, and modern design with clear style and layout rules.
